I will then estimate the outcomes and propose the one with the best margin.

I will draft a play with a 5% markdown, which maintains a net margin of 12.28%, above the category floor of 8%.

play.rationale: This play addresses an online sell-by breach for Masala Chips 200G by offering a 5% markdown at the outlet. This mechanic was chosen as transfers to other nodes resulted in negative expected margins, and the policy prefers markdowns as a last resort for such gaps. The expected margin for this play is 80.43 INR, with 22.98 units expected to be sold, avoiding 574.48 INR in waste. The markdown ensures the net margin remains above the category floor of 8%.
